source_title: Ishan Kishan ruled out of third T20I against New Zealand; Kumar Kushagra stays with India - Sportstar
source_excerpt: Ishan Kishan ruled out of third India vs New Zealand T20I in Wellington left Ishan Kishan’s recovery from injury is going well. ANI ANI https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/wmr0n6/article71625594.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/20261017409L.jpg ANI Bengaluru, Oct 17 (ANI): India's Ishan Kishan plays a shot during the 5th T20I against West Indies at M.Chinnaswamy Stadium, in Bengaluru on Saturday. (ANI Photo) Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of India’s third T20I against New Zealand in Wellington as he continues to recover from a right adductor strain. Ishan Kishan is recovering well from the low-grade right adductor strain he sustained during the first T20I against New Zealand. However, he is yet to regain match fitness and has been ruled out of the third T20I, scheduled for October 27, 2026, in Wellington. The BCCI medical team continues to monitor his recovery. Kumar Kushagra will remain with the Indian squad for the third T20I. Kishan’s injury prompted India to rejig its batting order in the series opener, promoting Tilak Varma to No. 3, Kishan’s usual position. Kishan batted at No. 5 and managed just one run off three balls before being caught on the leg-side boundary off Mitchell Santner. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, who had been on the bench for India’s previous four T20Is after featuring in the semifinal and final of its victorious Asian Games campaign, replaced Kishan in the XI for the second T20I and is likely to retain his place for the third match.
